items.rationale: The model only emits a tool_use request; the application runs the tool and returns the result.
Three requests end in tool_use replies, and a fourth, carrying the third result, gets the final answer: tool calls + 1.
Each request is stateless, so the full history is resent, and the tool_result carries the id of the request it answers.

items.answer: To stop a loop that never reaches end_turn from running forever and burning cost and time
accepted: the model might keep calling tools forever
items.rationale: The loop continues while stop_reason is tool_use; a model or malformed tool can keep it there, so a cap bounds cost and time.
Any stop reason other than tool_use ends the loop; end_turn means the model finished and its text is the answer.
